title: Colby and Jack Mousse Bites
description: A gluten-free take on the classic cheese bites, featuring a creamy mousse filling.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Colby cheese, Jack cheese, and Velvety cheese.
Stir until well combined and smooth.
Place a small amount of the cheese mixture onto each Wheat Thin.
Roll up the cheese and place seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the crackers are toasted.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
